notes.title: Localization & Tutorial Speed Improvements
notes.content:
[p]🌍 [b]Localization Fixes[/b]
Several language issues have been resolved:
• Japanese
• Korean
• Simplified Chinese
• Traditional Chinese[/p][p][b]Tutorial Text Update[/b]
Tutorial text now appears [b]50% faster[/b], making the early game flow more smoothly.[/p][p]Big thanks to everyone who provided feedback and reported these issues!
More updates are on the way.[/p]

notes.title: Tutorial Fixes & New Starting Café
notes.content:
[p]A new update is live![/p][p]This small patch addresses some key issues while improving the early game experience:[/p][p]• Fixed UI naming inconsistencies
• Resolved selling bugs with certain furniture items
• Ambient and SFX audio now play correctly
• Audio settings now save and apply properly
• Adjusted coffee prices for better balance
• Updated the default starting café
• Tutorial can no longer be broken or softlocked[/p][p][b]Note:[/b] Since the default starting café has been changed, we recommend starting a new game to experience the updated setup.[/p][p]Thanks again for all your support.
Your feedback plays a huge role in making the game better.[/p]

notes.title: Small Fixes & Smoother Café
notes.content:
Pushed a small update with some much needed fixes:

Customers shouldn’t clip into tables or sit weirdly anymore.

Drinking animations look a bit nicer now.

Cups actually go near the mouth this time, not the neck.

People walk a little further from walls so it feels less janky. Might tune it more later.

Thanks a ton for the feedback, seriously helps a lot. 
Keep it coming! 

Erman
<3

notes.title: The Demo is Live!
notes.content:
There’s plenty to explore already and more is on the way.

The demo will stay live until the full release and will receive updates as development progresses.
Some things might still be rough around the edges, but your feedback can help shape what comes next.

You can send feedback directly through the in-game button or by scanning the QR code inside the game.

Thanks for playing and taking the time to be part of this stage.
Feel free to join the community and share your thoughts:
[url=https://discord.com/invite/nDm2hPPMD6]Join Discord![/url]
